import sys


def main():
    jobs = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        parts = line.strip().split()
        if parts:
            name, arrival, duration, priority = parts
            jobs.append((name, int(arrival), int(duration), int(priority)))
    jobs.sort(key=lambda job: (-job[3], job[1], job[0]))
    time = 0
    idle = 0
    job_schedule = []
    while jobs:
        selected_job = None
        for job in jobs:
            if job[1] <= time:
                selected_job = job
                break
        if selected_job is None:
            idle += time
            time += 1
            continue
        job_schedule.append(selected_job)
        jobs.remove(selected_job)
        start = time
        end = start + selected_job[2]
        print(f"{selected_job[0]} {start} {end}")
        time = end
    print(f"idle {idle}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
